up: List all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727578. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES. Return one row per compound.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727578' AND cr.molregno IS NOT NULL
